==Usage==
This template should be used in conjunction with {{Tl|EndGame}}.

*To display a game, use the game name in the first parameter, and if necessary the altered name in the second parameter. 
*For use with a specific path in a video game, use "<nowiki>{{GameMechanics|option=1}}</nowiki>". 
*For use with a specific faction in a video game, use "<nowiki>{{GameMechanics|faction=Faction name}}</nowiki>". 
*To change the message to "the player chooses this character", use "<nowiki>{{GameMechanics|char=1}}</nowiki>".
*For Legends articles, use "<nowiki>{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}</nowiki>".
